analysis:
Documentation-only changes; no executable code, wire protocol, key custody, attestation, or encryption behavior changes in the supplied units. Coverage limit: for docs/architecture/inference.md only head-side excerpts were supplied (lines 403-1126, no patch), so which lines changed is unknown and the surrounding source was not reviewed. Docs describe:
- MTP idle-upgrade drain (lines 406-472): per-model admission fence, transient 503 slot_state, and a 120x500ms idle wait that discards the candidate on timeout, with other models unaffected. This is a bounded availability behavior (T-010/T-029 adjacent), and the doc states accepted work is not force-cancelled.
- Typical MTP acceptance default (lines 518-541): sampled output is approximate rather than distribution-exact, with an exact opt-out. This is an output-quality statement, not a confidentiality control. It touches T-007's output-integrity surface only via provider-side sampling, which the provider is already untrusted to perform honestly.
- MiMo native media decode accounting, memory admission, and the claim of no disk writes for in-memory video assets (lines 954-959). This is consistent with T-050 and does not regress it.
- Prefix-cache and SSD checkpoint statements (lines 565-583, 761-767): these defer to prefix-cache.md and do not alter the T-041 posture (HMAC names, 30-minute TTL, salt scoping).
- serving-performance-qualification.md: states that M5 Pro/Max/Ultra start at an unqualified legacy ceiling of 8, and that widths above 8 need a reviewed profile. This is a capacity-policy doc statement with no auth or attestation effect.
No threat-model update appears required. A later pass should confirm the code behind these docs (ModelIdleUpgrade, the MTP drain files, typical acceptance default-on, the M5 ceiling of 8) preserves the T-041 cache scoping and the fail-closed admission semantics if those source files appear in other units.
